question: Explain the nature of business economics.
sources: Nature and scope of business economics (standard economic theory)

points.label: Meaning
points.description: Business economics applies economic theory and methods to business decision-making, helping firms use scarce resources to reach their goals.

points.label: Science and art
points.description: It is a science because it studies cause-and-effect relations systematically, and an art because it applies this knowledge to solve practical problems.

points.label: Mainly micro with macro inputs
points.description: It is largely based on microeconomics (the firm, demand, cost, prices) but also uses macroeconomics to understand the environment, such as inflation, interest rates and government policy.
points.basis: Business economics: micro and macro content

points.label: Pragmatic and interdisciplinary
points.description: It is practical, adapting theory to real conditions, and draws on other subjects such as statistics, mathematics, accounting and management.
points.basis: Business economics: pragmatic and interdisciplinary nature

points.label: Normative and prescriptive
points.description: It is mainly normative, concerned with what ought to be done, and prescribes the best course of action for a firm.
